name: Éireamhón
text: Éireamhón is the modern Irish spelling of Éremón, the mythological founder of one of the two main branches of the early Irish. MacKillop reads the form as the contemporary rendering of the older name. The principal record sits under Éremón.

attributes.attribute: Modern Irish spelling of Éremón; pointer to Éremón headword

okr.objective: Éireamhón is a MacKillop signpost to Éremón.
key_results: Cites Éremón as the canonical headword.
Modern Irish form of the mythological founder.
